leadText: Volume 63 is the 63rd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the second volume of the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
Volume 63 is the 63rd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the second volume of the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
 Under orders from Joseph Stone, president of the Devon Corporation, the nefarious Pokémon energy absorption plan continues to move forward. Already filled with unease, Sapphire and Emerald are inexplicably attacked by Zinnia, another Trainer.

Meanwhile, can Ruby find the elusive Pokémon Rayquaza?!
